In the Surrey Schools Paul Richley gained the Silver in the Senior Boys 1500m with 4.07.7 and new member 14 year old Richard Addison came 4th in the 400m with 54.6.
Michael Blackmore who is just 15 ran 2.13.2 while Andrew Byrne failed to reproduce his training form but improved to 2.25.0. New boy Richard Addison ran 56.2 for his first 400m in Belgrave colours.

Simon who has been training under John Sullivan's guidance has been running for less than a year. 14 year old Richard Addison won the Boys Club 800m Championships in 2.18.6 with newcomer Jim Biesty second.

First year youth Dick Addison is planning to race indoors this winter and kept in touch with the track by racing in an open meeting at West London Stadium on November 3rd.The result was very satisfactory for Dick ran a P.B. 600m in 1.28.8.

The other early season record was Dick Addison's Youth 400m time of 49.9 set while winning the Surrey title. This eliminated John Gladwin's 50.5 but John was not idle having stretched to an easy 3.56 1500m in his first outing at West London Stadium.
Heading a list of excellent performances was the fine win in the Youths 400m by Dick Addison who erased Dave Mote's 6 year old record with an outstanding 49.9.
